 News › News News › Karwa Chauth school holiday 2026: Are schools closed on October 29? Check state-wise updates Karwa Chauth school holiday 2026: Are schools closed on October 29? Check state-wise updates
 Sajid Raza Updated: Oct 27, 2026, 16:46 IST Karwa Chauth School Holiday 2026 Karwa Chauth will be celebrated on Thursday, October 29, 2026. Students and parents are asking all over India if schools would be closed this time? Note that the holiday period might differ depending on the state, school board and school institutions since Karwa Chauth is not a mandatory school holiday throughout the country.
 School Holidays for Karwa Chauth 2026 can differ from state to state. Schools follow the holiday rules issued by their respective state education departments. Karwa Chauth is not a public holiday in the whole of India. Some states may add it to their limited holiday or optional holiday lists, and some governments may grant eligible employees leave. Students are advised to refer to their school's official holiday calendar or notice before arranging a day off.
 Karwa Chauth school holiday 2026: State-wise list 
 The following table summarises the available reports and holiday information. A special leave provision for teachers should not be confused with a confirmed holiday for students.
 State/Region Holiday status for October 29, 2026 
 Uttar Pradesh Reports indicate a holiday for eligible female teachers. Students should confirm whether their school will remain open. 
 Delhi Check the applicable school holiday calendar and official notice before assuming schools are closed. 
 Haryana Karwa Chauth is reported as a restricted or optional holiday; schools may operate normally. 
 Punjab Confirm the holiday status through the relevant state calendar or school notification. 
 Rajasthan Karwa Chauth appears as a restricted holiday in available holiday listings; this does not confirm a school closure. 
 Madhya Pradesh Check the state education department's calendar and the school's official announcement. 
 Bihar No confirmed statewide school closure has been established from the available information. 
 Other states and Union Territories Holiday arrangements depend on local rules and school calendars. 
 Important: Apart from the reported Uttar Pradesh provision and the available restricted-holiday listings, the above information should not be treated as confirmation of a state-wide school closure.
 The status of the school holiday in Uttar Pradesh, for the occasion of Karwa Chauth, is based on the guidelines that are given by the Basic and Secondary Education Department. 
 From the available data, it is revealed that the state government has announced October 29, 2026 as a holiday for women teachers. Teachers and school staff should, however, cross-check the official government notification to find out the rule of leave and whether the leave is applicable to the school.
 Why is Karwa Chauth celebrated? 
 Karwa Chauth is celebrated by married Hindu women, especially in north and west India. Women fast all day and pray for the health, happiness and longevity of their husbands.
 The festival usually includes the pre-dawn Sargi meal, prayers and the evening ritual of viewing the Moon before breaking the fast. There may be variations among regions and families.
 Upcoming school holidays after Karwa Chauth 2026
 Students may also look forward to other festivals and observances in the coming weeks. The actual dates of school closures will depend on local holiday calendars.
 Festival Date in 2026 Day 
 Karwa Chauth October 29 Thursday 
 Dhanteras November 6 Friday 
 Diwali November 8 Sunday 
 Govardhan Puja November 9 Monday 
 Bhai Dooj November 11 Wednesday 
 Chhath Puja November 15 Sunday 
 Guru Nanak Jayanti November 24 Tuesday 
 These are festival dates, not a guarantee of school holidays. Some schools may announce extended festive breaks, while others may remain open on certain days.
